Select molecule identifiers and properties for all molecules reported in document CHEMBL1154198. Return columns: molecule_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), molecule_name (from molecule_dictionary.pref_name), max_phase (from molecule_dictionary.max_phase), molecule_type (from molecule_dictionary.molecule_type), canonical_smiles (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles). Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then compound_records to docs on doc_id. LEFT JOIN compound_structures on molregno to include canonical_smiles, allowing nulls when structures are missing. Filter where docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1154198'. Do not deduplicate. Sort by molecule_chembl_id ascending.
